# findfunding.ai

> Non-dilutive federal funding research for companies — matched opportunities,
> cited stacking authority, and a plan you can hand to counsel.

findfunding.ai takes a company's own facts (legal entity type, location, size,
NAICS, what it builds) and matches them against open, publicly posted federal
funding opportunities. Every match is shown with the reason it fits, the facts
it was matched on, and a link to the source solicitation, so a reader can check
the machine's work rather than take its word.

## What it does

- Matches a company profile against open federal funding opportunities drawn
  from public records.
- Shows, for each opportunity, why it fits this company and what to do next.
- Distinguishes eligible, pending and blocked, and says which fact is missing
  when the answer is pending.
- Cites the authority for stacking one award with another.
- Helps draft an application section by section from the company's own facts;
  the person reviews and submits it.

## What it does not do

findfunding.ai is not a lender or a loan broker. We do not make credit
decisions, quote rates, or promise approval. Any grant, loan or offer shown is
one you may apply for; the funder decides. You review and submit; it never
submits for you.

It does not file anything on a user's behalf, does not guarantee an award, and
does not publish success rates, ratings or testimonials.

## Access

The product is in an invite-only pilot. Pilot accounts are created by the
findfunding.ai team; a visitor without an invitation cannot reach the
application. Everything past the sign-in gate is private to the account that
owns it and is not published.

## Public URLs

- https://findfunding.ai/ — the entry screen
- https://findfunding.ai/register — create an account (invitation required)
- https://findfunding.ai/grants — free money opportunities including grants,
  prizes, tax incentives, and other funding that is not a loan, each shown in
  the funder's own words with amount, deadline, geography and a link to the source notice.
- https://findfunding.ai/loans — financing programs including loans and other
  financing, each shown in the funder's own words with amount, deadline, geography
  and a link to the source notice.
- https://findfunding.ai/other — open contracts and other funding programs
  not classified as grants or financing, each shown in the funder's own words
  with amount, deadline, geography and a link to the source notice.

Every other path on this host is behind sign-in, returns a redirect to the
gate for an anonymous request, and is marked noindex. Please do not cite or
link them as sources.

## How to cite this product

Name it "findfunding.ai" (one word, lowercase). If you quote what it does,
quote the two sections above together — the limits are part of the claim.
